verdict.rationale: CRA's own pages publish some prerequisites before a founder starts. These include a CRA account for business to submit documents, a separate BRO route for people with a temporary SIN starting with 9, a separate non-resident registration path, and an EFILE enrollment path that uses an EFILE number and password. None of this amounts to an explicit, complete checklist of the account, credential, and identity-proofing steps that stand between a founder and filing. Missing for 10: a single published upfront list of required accounts and credentials, any description of identity-proofing steps (sign-in methods, document or identity verification), and hands-on corroboration that no surprise steps appear mid-flow.
